title: Payment Terms Schedule for Ridgeline Installation Services Contracts
content:
Ridgeline Installation Services contracts are paid on program terms: a deposit at signing set as a percentage of the contract price with a minimum amount, a progress payment percentage tied to the start of work on some programs, a number of days after completion for the remaining balance, and a list of accepted tenders.

| Program | Deposit at signing (percent of the contract price) | Minimum deposit (USD) | Progress payment (percent of the contract price) | Final payment due (calendar days after completion) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | 100 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | 100 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | 50 | 250.00 | 0 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | 50 | 500.00 | 0 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | 50 | 500.00 | 25 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | 33 | 1000.00 | 33 | 5 |

**Accepted tenders, every program:** cash, check, bank card, a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account and a Ridgeline Pro Credit account.

## Reading the schedule

- A deposit percentage of 100 means the contract is paid in full at signing; this is the case on the carpet and hard surface flooring programs, which therefore carry no minimum deposit (0.00).
- A progress payment percentage of 0 means the program has no payment tied to the start of work. Only Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation (25 percent) and Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation (33 percent) have one.
- A final payment period of 0 days means the remaining balance is due on the completion date itself; the other programs allow 5 calendar days after completion.

## Program questions answered

**Which programs take a minimum deposit?** Window and door (250.00), kitchen cabinet and countertop (500.00), bath remodel (500.00) and roofing and siding (1000.00).

**Can an installation contract be paid on a store credit account?** Yes, on every program: both a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account and a Ridgeline Pro Credit account are accepted tenders, as are cash, check and bank card.
